Solar Basics

Photovoltaic Panels
Solar panels make use of the sun’s energy to convert it into DC power.

Micro-Inverters
Micro-inverters enable you to use current to power up your home.

Service Panel
This panel is in charge of the solar energy that your home uses; it distributes the energy to the circuits.

AC Combiner Box
This box includes the equipment; it makes it easy for you to monitor your power production.

Utility Meter
Utility meters measure the amount of power your house is creating and tells you if any of the power can be outsourced.

The Breaker Box
The breaker box enables the electricity to flow to the outlets in your home, turning solar energy into electricity!
